# Did your workers' comp audit overcharge you?

> Free tool for small employers: enter your workers' comp premium audit worksheet and your own records, see which lines are worth disputing (overtime, uninsured subcontractors, officer payroll, class) in dollars, and copy a dispute note.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
